name: Venomancer: a weapon swap in Spider Form updates main-hand damage at once (#8864)
contract: #8864: Spider Form 800841 applies SPELL_AURA_MOD_SHAPESHIFT misc 52 (SpellShapeshiftForm 52, attackSpeed 0). Unit::IsInFeralForm lists FORM_VENOMANCER_SPIDER, so Player::_ApplyWeaponDamage stores the new weapon's base damage but returns before UpdateDamagePhysical; UNIT_FIELD_MINDAMAGE keeps the old weapon's value until InitDataForForm runs on the next form change. Because form 52 does not override attack speed, Player::CalculateMinMaxDamage uses the equipped weapon's damage in this form, so the same weapon in the same form must give the same main-hand damage whether it was equipped before or after shifting. Worn Dagger 2092 (1.1607-3.4821, 1600 ms) and Short Staff 2132 (6-10, 3200 ms) have no stats, so the swap changes no attack power. Expected: after equipping the staff in Spider Form the minimum damage rises above the dagger value (unscaled base difference 6 - 1.1607 = 4.84) and equals the value after leaving and re-entering the form.

steps.label: Equip Worn Dagger in the main hand
SETUP: Worn Dagger is in the main hand
Let the form's stat update settle
Swap to Short Staff while in Spider Form
SETUP: Short Staff is in the main hand
SETUP: Spider Form survives the swap
DISCRIMINATING: the staff swap raises main-hand minimum damage in Spider Form
Re-enter Spider Form with the staff
SETUP: Spider Form is active again
Let the form's stat update settle
DISCRIMINATING: re-entering the form leaves the swapped damage unchanged
